maria: hey team — need access to the model-health dashboard for eu-west (model-serving-prod) to triage a flurry of 502s this morning. anyone with perms who can share link or add me to viewer group? :wave:
ajay: which dashboard exactly? there are a few — service-overview? model-latency? 
maria: the one titled "Model Health — production" under /dashboards/model-serving/ — shows per-region error rates, token throughput, and model version KPIs. I can paste the panel id if helpful.
ajay: got it. @tom or @jess, can you grant maria read? infra team controls grafana groups.
tom: I can add her. maria, are you ok with being in infra-monitoring (read-only)?
maria: yes please.
tom: done — you should have viewer access now. link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd1234/model-health-production?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west
maria: I can see it, thanks! :tada: quick q — where should I look for the 502 traces? logs/kibana?
jess: traces are in Tempo (traces.redwood.example) and logs in Kibana (https://kibana.redwood.example/app/discover#/?_g=()). Start with traces for the trace ID in the 502 panel, then check nginx logs in kibana index nginx-logs-*.
ajay: FYI the 502s are likely from model backend container OOMs — we've seen a pattern. If it's consistent, we should tune the alert. current alert: rate > 5/min for 2m. suggests we slack the window or switch to anomaly detection.
maria: can someone adjust the alert while I investigate? it's noisy for the oncall.
tom: don't want to change without an incident ticket. please open a quick ticket in #incidents (or in Jira) with observed timestamps and I'll adjust to 5/min over 5m temporarily.
maria: opened incident 3456 in Jira — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3456
jess: thanks. Tom, proposed alert change: increase window to 5m and threshold to 8/min for eu-west only, and add a suppression for deploy tag. If we see real degradation we'll revert.
tom: will implement after verifying in staging. ping me here when you have a repro.
maria: noted, will paste traces in the ticket. thanks everyone :heart:
deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-17T09:02:00Z completed on model-serving-prod, revision b7f3c4. (reacted with :eyes:)
ajay: linking snippet to add viewer via cli:
```
./grafctl rbac add-user --user maria --group infra-monitoring --org 1
```
maria: got it and verified. closing this thread once ticket concluded.
